d:
Kunal Kapur is an Indian celebrity chef and restaurateur, best known as the host and judge of the TV series MasterChef India Season 1, 2 and 3 aired on Star Plus and Junior Masterchef India Season 1. He was born in New Delhi to a Punjabi family in 18 September, 1979.
He began his cooking lessons from his father and grandfather and nurtured this love to become one of the finest chefs not just in India but across the globe.
He was also awarded Sir Edmund Hillary scholarship in the field of beverage and cooking from the government of New Zealand.
